subject: Exec clearance request: special Hosted API concession (>20%) for Northbridge Robotics
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Deal Desk <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2029-04-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Exec clearance for >20% Hosted API concession — Northbridge Robotics

Team,

I need exec approval for a non-standard Hosted API concession for Northbridge Robotics (deal ND-4821). They are asking for a 30% unit-rate discount on Hosted API usage for a 12-month term in return for a multi-region deployment (US + EU) and co-marketing. The ask is driven by their projected ramp: ~1.2B tokens over 12 months with heavy steady-state traffic (peak bursts).

Why this matters:
- Strategic: Northbridge is an embed partner for robotics control; public reference could open us to manufacturing verticals.
- Volume: The committed token spend is materially large and front-loaded to Q3.
- Competition: They are evaluating two other vendors and price sensitivity is high.

Anchor economics we propose:
- 30% off list Hosted API unit price
- 12-month minimum commit: $1.2M billed monthly
- Auto-escalator for overages to prevent deep margin erosion (overage at list price)

Attached: northbridge_MOU.pdf and usage_forecast_Q3-Q4.xlsx and initial redlines from their legal team.

Request: Exec signoff to grant up to 30% concession contingent on legal-approved SOW and minimum commit. If approved, I will route to legal for doc prep and to billing for committed revenue terms.

Thanks,
Mina
Mina Haddad
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2029-04-11T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Exec clearance for >20% Hosted API concession — Northbridge Robotics

Mina —

Thanks for the summary and attachments. A few clarifying items before I take to the pricing committee: 
1) Can you confirm the recommended blended rate target (post-30% discount) and the current list unit price you want to discount from?
2) Is the $1.2M a committed ARR or a 12-month committed spend (billing/capacity guarantee)?
3) Any credit period or payment terms requested (Net30/Net45)?
4) Are there redundancy/regional hosting SKUs required that would increase cost?

If we move forward with 30% I want to ensure we have: minimum commitment locked, an overage price at list, and a three-month ramp clause so we can re-evaluate if traffic exceeds forecasts.

-Karthik
Deal Desk
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2029-04-11T11:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Exec clearance for >20% Hosted API concession — Northbridge Robotics

Karthik — quick answers inline:
1) List unit price: $0.0008 per token (standard T3 profile). 30% off = $0.00056 per token. Blended is expected to be slightly lower in practice due to batching but use $0.00056 as the committed price.
2) $1.2M is a 12-month committed spend (billing guarantee) with monthly invoicing.
3) They prefer Net45 but will accept Net30 with early-pay credit. Finance has flagged Net45 as possible for strategic accounts but would need approval from Laura.
4) Multi-region (US + EU) required; they will run active-active but no special hardware SKUs beyond our standard Dedicated-hosted routing. Expect ~6% incremental infra cost due to egress and region replication.

I also pulled their legal redlines; the core asks are around liability caps and data residency language — nothing we haven't seen. Attaching contract_redlines_v1.docx.

If the pricing committee approves 30% we can lock in with an SOW and milestone payments for the first 90 days to mitigate credit exposure.

Mina
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2029-04-11T13:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Exec clearance for >20% Hosted API concession — Northbridge Robotics

Folks — got a quick read and I support granting the concession with conditions. Northbridge is strategic for our robotics vertical and the reference potential is high. Conditions I want enforced if we approve 30%: 
- Signed 12-month MRC (minimum recurring commitment) of $1.2M.
- Payments on Net30; Net45 only with CFO approval.
- Quarterly business review clause and a traffic/quality SLA that triggers review if 3-month rolling avg exceeds forecast by >25%.
- Legal to accept our standard liability cap; no elevated indemnities.

Laura — requesting you to confirm finance tolerance for Net45 if they push, otherwise Net30 is preferred.

Ben
Director, Strategic Accounts
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2029-04-11T15:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Exec clearance for >20% Hosted API concession — Northbridge Robotics

Ben/Mina —

After reviewing the numbers and the strategic rationale, finance will approve the 30% Hosted API unit concession with the following binding conditions: 
1) Clear committed spend of $1.2M over 12 months (monthly invoices) — this is non-negotiable.
2) Payment terms: Net30. We will not accept Net45 for this concession without a signed personal guarantee from the founders; negotiate Net30.
3) Early termination claw: if Northbridge terminates before 12 months without cause, remaining committed spend becomes immediately due as a termination fee.
4) Overage pricing: all usage beyond committed tokens billed at list price, payable monthly.
5) Legal must clear the liability language; no expanded indemnities beyond our standard template.

With those in place, you have my exec-level authorization to offer 30% as described. Route the final SOW to Legal and Billing and copy Finance when contract is signed.

Laura Bennett
VP, Finance — Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
